product_metadata.title: Impulse Heat Sealer / Plastic Bag Sealer (8" (200mm))
features: Adjustable timer: use for mylar or plastic bags of different thicknesses
Ready for use: no warm-up required
Airtight seals for food, parts, and product storage
Includes free heating element repair kit
Use for PVA, PVC, mylar, saran, polyethylene, cellophane, polypropylene
description: The impulse heat sealer is suitable for sealing all varieties of mylar and plastic bags. It creates airtight seals for your food storage and product packaging needs. Simply adjust the timer knob for appropriate seal strength, selecting a longer time for thicker plastic.
